# PCUI API

> The API reference of `@playcanvas/pcui` {{VERSION}}: the UI components of browser-based tools such as the PlayCanvas Editor, and the bindings that connect them to observer data.

Each link leads to a Markdown page with the symbol's properties and methods. React wrappers of the components are exported from `@playcanvas/pcui/react`. For guides, see the [PCUI index](https://developer.playcanvas.com/user-manual/pcui/llms.txt) of the User Manual.
